summary.text: Software Engineer from IIIT Lucknow with production experience at Zomato and Even Healthcare, building backend systems in Go, TypeScript, gRPC, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Codeforces Expert with strong DSA/problem-solving background and experience improving high-throughput logistics, healthcare, and internal platform systems.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Owned backend development for Even Infinite's Hospital Pass, improving member access to partner-hospital services and increasing pass engagement by 65%+.
Designed an AI-assisted clinical follow-up framework using LLM-based report summarization, care-manager recommendations, and automated call flows, reducing manual follow-up effort by ~40%.
Built reusable onboarding infrastructure for insurance providers with automated CI/CD workflows, reducing provider integration time from 6 weeks to 2 weeks.
Resolved recurring document generation and re-upload failures in post-hospitalization workflows, restoring reliable generation of 300+ weekly care-manager forms.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Built an automated vehicle onboarding workflow with plate detection and dynamic step routing across 15 screens, reducing manual review effort by 60% and onboarding errors by 80%.
Redesigned delayed-order ticketing workflows with automated escalation states and operator actions, reducing cancellation-prone cases by 80%.
Migrated logistics map tooling to Google Maps and optimized API usage patterns, reducing map-related operating costs by 25%.
Built a Python-based sync pipeline for ~1M support tickets, automating recurring operations workflows and eliminating 95% of manual sync effort.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
achievements: Migrated 200+ legacy JavaScript components to TypeScript and Redux inside a large Next.js monorepo, reducing build-time errors by 40% and improving development velocity by 30%.
Built a production-safe Go SDK to stream multi-GB ZIP archives directly to S3, reducing transfer latency by 65% and cutting peak memory usage by 50%.
Developed a GPS ingestion service processing ~50k location events/sec with monitoring dashboards, improving ETA prediction accuracy by 12%.
Refactored service-to-service RPC flows using goroutines and gRPC batching, reducing P95 latency by 95% at ~2k TPS.

experience.title: Backend Developer Intern
achievements: Scaled a Strapi-based ERM platform to support ~1k RPS by adding in-memory caching, optimizing SQL queries, and restructuring backend routes.
Automated deployment and hosting setup using AWS, Docker, Nginx, Certbot, and reusable scripts, reducing manual infrastructure setup effort.

experience.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Intern
achievements: Developed backend and dashboard workflows for a Next.js platform used by the UP Commercial Tax Department, including automated PDF-based discrepancy tax report generation that reduced manual effort by 60%.
Implemented WAF protections, API validation, and access-control improvements for sensitive government-facing workflows.
